## B. Corrections to our own papers

### B1. My judicial affidavit (sworn 23 January 2026)

| Where | Reads | Should read | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Statement of purposes, (g) and (h) | "September 26, 2019" (twice) | **September 29, 2016** | Exhibit "H" (the deed, stamped "SEP 29 2016" at both the signature line and the acknowledgment); my own Q35 and Q37; Entry No. 2021003235 on T-52540 ("dated September 29, 2016") |
| Answers to Q11 and Q12 | "28,981 square meters" (twice) | **28,891 square meters** | T-52540 (Exhibit "B"); Entry No. 2021003236: 2,587 + 26,304 = 28,891 |

Two further wording points in Q26 that I propose to soften on the stand, subject to your view: "misappropriated" (I will say Cesar never remitted the proceeds), and that the co-owners "directly informed Cesar" of the 2005 revocation (I have no personal knowledge of notice to Cesar, and Salvador dela Fuente denies it in his affidavit).

### B2. Complaint ¶50 is contradicted by our own Exhibit "B"

¶50 states that Cesar's SPA "was annotated [on T-52540] only on November 23, 2021." The certified memorandum of encumbrances on T-52540 (Exhibit "B", page 3) shows the 16 March 1992 SPA **presented and annotated on 21 June 1996** (PE-196220-227-21, carried over from the parent title: "to sign, negotiate for the sale of the parcel of land in this title … acknowledged before Ramon C. Munda, Consul, on March 16, 1992"). It was re-annotated on 23 November 2021 as Entry No. 2021003235. So in 2016 the title did show Cesar's SPA. There is **no revocation entry** on the title at any date. Atty. Ramos can use ¶50 against us. I will not repeat it on the stand; I will rest on the SPA's terms, not on notice of revocation.
